main_evaluation: HANS: 30000 pairs x 3 seeds, three heuristic families, entailment vs non-entailment
runtime_scope: CUDA eager only, seed 42, repeated timing and memory measurements
primary_model_comparison_caveat: Saved FP32 HANS predictions generated on GPU, adopted INT8 HANS predictions generated on CPU; no CPU FP32 control run.
statistics_caveat: McNemar q-values are Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted across 18 seed x heuristic x gold-label tests; paired bootstrap CIs are unadjusted. Seed-level result is n=3 independent training runs.
no_unitless_accuracy_percentages: All columns ending _pct contain values on 0-100 scale. All changes ending _pp are signed percentage points, not fractions.
repeated_grain_note: Master includes repeated seed- and group-level fields on multiple subcase rows; never SUM these fields without deduplicating.
